source_units.text: Ahead of an attack maneuver in inland hilly terrain, the tank company activated a MUM-T system combining three reconnaissance drones and a lightweight TDSS.
TDSS self-diagnosis, normal communication confirmation, launch of 3 drones, and HMI integrated SA display were performed.
The company commander shared the surveillance status with each platoon, and the TDSS made the initial transmission of company SA summary information to the battalion server.
The 1st Platoon moved in wedge formation and the drones surveilled forward and the left and right flanks.
Drone 1 picked up the suspected enemy observation post heat source and the company commander decided on the right bypass maneuver.
When the bypass maneuver started, Drone 3 was redeployed ahead of the bypass axis and the TDSS updated SA.
Drone 1 Edge AI detected the possibility of 3-4 FPV drones and the TDSS displayed the approach speed and time of arrival on the HMI.
The enemy began electronic warfare jamming, and the packet loss rate persisted above the threshold, so the TDSS began the transition from normal to limited.
Even in limited communication mode, the TDSS updated minimum SA with summary track data and performed graceful degradation.
During limited mode, FPV drones approached toward the 1st Platoon and the 2nd Platoon, and the platoons performed alert-based evasive and dispersed maneuvers.
The electronic warfare attack intensity increased, and after confirming the disappearance of the remaining FPV threat, the company commander ordered assembly and damage check.
GPS reliability and heartbeat degraded, and the TDSS declared the transition from limited mode to communication blackout mode.
The reconnaissance drones detected the heartbeat dropout, switched to emergency broadcast mode, and transmitted threat data directly.
In the blackout state, additional FPV and ATGM threats occurred, and each platoon performed evasive actions based on broadcast alerts and its own sensors.
The company commander's tank maintained minimum SA, and Drone 1 landed due to battery depletion, so the surveillance area was reduced.
When intermittent communication signals were picked up again and the Drone 2 link was kept stable, the TDSS began the transition from blackout to limited.

Voice communication between the company commander and the subordinate platoons, the connection between the TDSS and the battalion server, and bandwidth recovered, and the transition to normal mode began.

The company commander sent the comprehensive report on the blackout period to the battalion, and the battalion server judged that the enemy electronic warfare unit had withdrawn and the remaining threat was small-scale.
The TDSS confirmed stabilization of normal communication mode and reactivated the operational activity groups, and the company commander ordered maneuver resumption.
Drone 2 confirmed the remaining force, and the subordinate platoons suppressed the remaining enemy positions and then organized defensive positions.
The company commander reported the objective secured, and the key transitions proceeded in the order normal-limited-blackout-limited-normal.

scenarios.summary: The tank company performs the attack maneuver using reconnaissance drones and the TDSS and, going through the enemy observation post, FPV/ATGM threats, electronic warfare jamming, communication blackout, and recovery, secures the objective.

episodes.label: Operation environment and MUM-T system activation
episodes.summary: In the inland hilly terrain environment, the company commander prepares to use the TDSS and drone ISR.

episodes.label: TDSS diagnostics, drone launch, SA sharing

episodes.label: Normal communication attack maneuver

episodes.label: Enemy observation post detection and bypass maneuver
episodes.summary: Based on Drone 1 and the battalion analysis, the company commander decides on the right bypass maneuver.

episodes.label: FPV threat detection and dispersed response
episodes.summary: The FPV drone approach is detected, the TDSS provides an HMI alert, and the platoons perform dispersed maneuver.

episodes.label: Electronic warfare jamming and limited communication mode
episodes.summary: Due to the increased packet loss rate, communication transitions from normal communication to limited communication, and the drones switch to Edge AI mode.

episodes.label: Communication blackout and local survival
episodes.summary: Due to heartbeat loss, communication blackout mode is declared, and the drone emergency broadcast and local survival loop operate.

episodes.label: Communication recovery and mission resumption
episodes.summary: Communication recovers from blackout to limited and from limited to normal, and the company resumes the attack and secures the objective.
